race.comment: FERREL'S LAW (3) started big odds last time but hit the ground running with a fast early split, paving the way for a 1.75 lengths win at this track over 300m in 16.83. Has hit winning form and can measure up again. ZIPPING GLINDA (1) was game in defeat off a low draw at the latest outing, finishing second and beaten 2 lengths (23.26) behind Cindy Cabang at Geelong. The form out of her last race has been franked. Bold showing expected. SCOTT THE POP (8) held her own to the line last start and filled a minor placing, beaten only 0.9 lengths (16.95) behind Marshall Bear at this track. The form from her last run stacks up well. Expected to be in this for a long way. ZIPPING DARLA (2) has ability and finds the right scenario to bounce back.
